verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Pandoc's error reporting, exit codes, or warnings that explain why a conversion failed. The only related items are a tip to inspect intermediate LaTeX when debugging PDF output, which is a user-side debugging workaround and not failure reporting. There is also a community report that Unicode fallback silently dropped characters, which runs against the story.

support.subject: As a developer, a failed conversion reports why it failed (unsupported feature, corrupt input) instead of silently emitting a broken file
